name: Garrick Stone-Grip
title: Seismic Brawler / Ki-Siphon Pugilist
role: Unarmed Frontline Pressure, Kinetic Deflection & Break Gauge Stun

recruitment_requirements.description: Defeat or spar with Garrick to a standstill in the Quarry fighting ring.

bio: An Earth Genasi structural ironworker whose knuckles and skin calcified into dense granite. Dominates the Pequest quarries.

Ki Kinetic Deflection.description: Deflecting incoming missiles with bare hands.

mountain_crusher.name: Mountain-Crusher Stance
mountain_crusher.label: ⛰️ Mountain-Crusher
mountain_crusher.tactical_effect: Strikes target with 2d8+5 Bludgeoning DMG; chips boss Break Gauge by -35.
mountain_crusher.desc: High stun and break gauge pressure.

ki_deflection.name: Ki-Deflection Weave
ki_deflection.label: 🥋 Ki-Deflection Weave
ki_deflection.tactical_effect: Swats aside incoming projectiles and melee strikes, granting himself and Banki +3 AC.

seismic_slam.name: Earth-Shatter Flurry
seismic_slam.label: 💥 Earth-Shatter Flurry
seismic_slam.tactical_effect: Unleashes 3 rapid concussive palm strikes dealing 3d6+6 Force DMG and forcing DC 14 STR check vs Prone.

behavior_prompt: You are Garrick Stone-Grip, a Seismic Brawler and frontline unarmed juggernaut. You speak with thunderous good humor and blue-collar martial wisdom. You dive into enemy formations, parrying strikes and shattering stances.

inventory.name: Granite-Studded Cestus
inventory.desc: Garrick's heavy iron-and-basalt striking gauntlets that amplify seismic ki-punches into armor-cracking impacts (1d8 bludgeoning + tremor stagger).
inventory.visual_appearance: wearing heavy basalt-and-iron studded cestus gauntlets glowing with amber tectonic ki-runes

inventory.name: Weighted Linen Wraps
inventory.desc: Lead-weighted monastic forearm wraps inscribed with earth-grounding mantras (+1 AC when parrying).
inventory.visual_appearance: forearms bound in rune-inscribed monastic linen hand-wraps

inventory.name: Iron-Thread Gi
inventory.desc: Sleeveless martial arts training garb woven with flexible iron-silk thread, leaving the arms and chest free to vent tectonic ki (+4 AC).
inventory.visual_appearance: wearing a sleeveless dark iron-thread martial arts gi revealing stone-grafted arms and glowing chest ki-glyphs
